title: Campus Safety Assessment
description: Evaluates the overall safety infrastructure, emergency preparedness, and hazard management on campus to ensure a safe environment for students, faculty, and staff

questions.text: Are all emergency exits clearly marked, unobstructed, and inspected regularly?
Is a CCTV surveillance system installed across key campus areas and monitored actively?
Are fire extinguishers placed at designated points and serviced within the last 12 months?
Is there a functional anti-ragging committee with clear escalation procedures?
Are laboratory safety protocols (PPE availability, chemical storage, emergency shower) in place?
Is access control implemented at campus entry/exit points with visitor management?
Has an emergency response plan been tested through a drill in the last 12 months?

title: Academic Integrity Assessment
description: Reviews the institute's policies and systems to uphold academic honesty, research ethics, and fair evaluation practices

questions.text: Is there a published academic integrity and anti-plagiarism policy accessible to all students and faculty?
Is plagiarism detection software used for evaluating student submissions and research papers?
Is there a defined process for investigating and resolving academic misconduct complaints?
Are examination procedures (invigilation, secure paper distribution, result publication) standardized and auditable?
Is a research ethics committee (or equivalent) active for reviewing research involving human participants?
